key_insight: Integrating LLM guidance with numerical optimization can accelerate simulation-based redesign and improve the likelihood of finding near-optimal designs.
engineering_relevance: LLMs can use engineering context and changed requirements to guide costly simulator-based searches when adapting existing designs.
method: Compare three LLM integration methods: warm start, variable fixing and ReAct.
Pair LLM guidance with Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search and random search.
Evaluate electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization across four types of redesign scenarios.
evidence_signal: In the battery pack study, the integrated approach matched baseline feasible-design discovery with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs finding near-optimal solutions.
watch_item: The best integration strategy depends on the requirement change, and results from this battery pack case study may not generalize to other engineering systems.
